title: 艾克·发条小玩具
description: 白色高发的艾克穿实用街头服，在小桌前修发条玩具，时间装置背在身后。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Ekko is a dark-skinned teenage inventor with a tall white mohawk, a pale painted mark across his face, and a bright red scarf. Preserve his layered practical Zaun street clothes, opaque trousers, wraps, and boots, with the recognizable time device secured on his back. His bat-like tool rests horizontally on a low bench, inactive and separate from his working hands.
art_direction.scene: He leans comfortably over a small worktable, turning a simple gear on a tiny clockwork bird with a short screwdriver. A few large spare cogs and one closed tool tin keep the tabletop readable. His expression is curious and playful, with a plain brick wall and rounded window behind him rather than a chaotic action scene.
art_direction.palette: warm brown, white hair, scarf red, turquoise
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
